title: Dummy Backend Todo Autocomplete
description: Implement an autocomplete input that suggests todo titles from the dummy backend's /api/todos endpoint.
requirements: Fetch todos from http://localhost:4000/api/todos on mount and store them in state
Track an input value in query state and bind it to a text input with placeholder 'Search todos...'
While loading, show an element with class 'status' containing text 'Loading suggestions...'
On error, show an element with class 'status error' displaying 'Error: <message>'
When not loading and not error and the trimmed query is non-empty, show an element with class 'status empty' and text 'No matches found.' if there are no matching suggestions
Otherwise, render a ul with class 'suggestions' containing li elements with class 'suggestion-item' for each matching todo title
Clicking a suggestion should set the input value to that title and render a div with class 'selected' showing 'Selected: <title>'

hints.filter: Use toLowerCase() and includes() so the search is case-insensitive.
hints.empty: Only show the 'No matches found.' message when the user has typed something but suggestions is empty.
hints.selection: Store the full selected todo so you can easily show more details later.
